name: Sea of Nyx
slug: Carlkin keeps a first edition of the Sea of Nyx that the party was part of.
description: The Sea of Nyx is a written chronicle, also heard once as Sea of Nyxs. The party was part of what the DM calls its first edition.

log.summary: Carlkin has papers the DM calls a first edition of the Sea of Nyx mixed on his tables with newer pages of various ages and much older tomes.
